body.p: The sun and the moon are friends. The sun helps and protects the moon. If anybody wants to kill the moon, the sun says, "He is my friend, I will kill you." The sun went off to catch lice. He found white lice and gave some of them to the moon. The moon was not satisfied with these lice and said. "I am an expert in catching lice." He went off, but he didn't return. The sun said, "What is the matter with the moon?" He went to look for him. He found the moon very ill. One of the lice the moon had caught had bored a big hole in his head. The sun brought a comb, dressed his hair and the moon was well again.
